question: In a certain code language, “ENSURE” is written as “FPVTPB”, and “EQUITY” is written as “FSXHRV”. How will “FINGER” be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d2ed7cb389f255cb08fa16e580ec1ec9c6eda2c5159639ee6f069b323b54c4f.png] 

Here, the following logic is used

“ENSURE” = “FPVTPB” 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35dc46f9ae0f6fe3d792bbe2f4cb080dd5656f690e5902150a8247fb71984b72.png] 

“EQUITY” = “FSXHRV” 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b71c22afdafd30eacb79f54eae73a2717f11a1803ccf6ef65b4da76ba6d68b3.png] 

“FINGER” =' '?''

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb4111c69cb348d30c0ca70a98e0888a3c56dd6ae60450463f985770694a2fc3.png] 

From the above image, **'?'** will be coded as '**GKQFCO'**

Hence, the correct answer is option(4).
